UnitStatement: The scc-resolution-case skill is used when WORKING_ITEMS needs to create or update a PKG-00 SCC case file.
An SCC resolution case brief must set `TaskSkill` to `scc-resolution-case`.
An SCC resolution case brief requires `ApplyEdits: true`.
Allowed write targets for the brief are limited to the SCC case folder and a scoped `_run_records` folder.
Runtime overrides for the brief must identify CASE_ID, CASE_PATH, CASE_TITLE, SCC_ID, DEPCLOSURE_SNAPSHOT, AFFECTED_DELIVERABLES, and CASE_STATE.
Expected outputs for a case brief include contract, datasheet, findings, evidence, remedies, rulings, open questions, handoff, and QA artifacts.
`SEED_PACKET_PATHS` names prior packets to preserve under `case-seeds/`.
`SCC_NODE_SET` provides a semicolon-separated SCC node set.
`FOCUS_PAIRS` provides semicolon-separated bidirectional pairs.
Existing scope-change packets must be treated as seed evidence rather than active SCOPE_CHANGE intake.
The skill must not edit product deliverables, dependency registers, decomposition files, `_ScopeChange/`, or `_Reconciliation/`.
The skill must not report SCC closure or project-wide blocked/unblocked status.
Required case files must exist.
Required CSV columns must be present.
`CaseState` must be one of the canonical lifecycle states.
Every candidate remedy must have evidence or a `TBD` reason.
Every owner handoff must name an owning workflow.
Case text must not claim SCC closure unless cited DepClosure evidence proves it.
PKG-00 must not contain `Dependencies.csv`.
Seed packets must be labeled as seed evidence and not active SCOPE_CHANGE intake.
`CLOSED_BY_DEPCLOSURE` is valid only when `Case_QA.md` cites follow-up DepClosure evidence that proves the SCC is absent or formally accepted by the owning reconciliation workflow.
An SCC Resolution Case accumulates bounded TASK findings, evidence, human rulings, candidate remedies, owner-workflow handoffs, and eventual DepClosure evidence.
The scc-resolution-case skill does not resolve an SCC by itself.
The suitable shell is TASK in generic shell mode with ScopePath set to a PKG-00 control deliverable folder or the case folder.
ScopePath must be a PKG-00 control deliverable folder or case folder.
CASE_ID is the local case ID.
CASE_PATH is the absolute output folder inside the control deliverable `scc-cases/` directory.
CASE_TITLE is the human-readable case title.
SCC_ID is the SCC identifier from DepClosure.
DEPCLOSURE_SNAPSHOT is the accepted upstream DepClosure snapshot.
AFFECTED_DELIVERABLES is a semicolon-separated list of deliverable IDs.
CASE_STATE must be one canonical case lifecycle state.

Canonical case lifecycle states are OPEN_FOR_TASK_WORK, EVIDENCE_ACCUMULATING, HUMAN_RULINGS_PENDING, REMEDY_CLASSIFIED, READY_FOR_OWNER_WORKFLOWS, DEP_CLOSURE_PENDING, CLOSED_BY_DEPCLOSURE, and BLOCKED_TBD.
The read boundary includes the PKG-00 control deliverable in scope.
The read boundary includes existing case files under CASE_PATH.
The read boundary includes existing `case-seeds/` artifacts.
The read boundary includes cited DepClosure snapshot evidence.
The read boundary includes explicitly affected product deliverable evidence when needed for case indexing.
The skill must not scan unrelated packages except to resolve explicitly listed affected deliverables.
The write boundary includes `Case_Contract.md` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Case_Datasheet.md` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Task_Findings.csv` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Evidence_Register.csv` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Candidate_Remedies.csv` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Ruling_Register.csv` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Open_Questions.md` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Owner_Workflow_Handoff.md` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary includes `Case_QA.md` under CASE_PATH.
The write boundary permits `case-seeds/` only when preserving prior packet artifacts.
The write boundary permits scoped TASK run records under ScopePath or CASE_PATH `_run_records`.
The skill must never write product package files.
The skill must never write any `Dependencies.csv`.
The skill must never write `_ScopeChange/`.
The skill must never write `_Reconciliation/`.
The skill must never write decomposition files.
`Case_Contract.md` defines contribution rules, TASK deposit protocol, authority limits, and owner-workflow boundaries.
`Case_Datasheet.md` records SCC identity, node set, latest DepClosure baseline, affected deliverables, current case state, and seed artifacts.
`Task_Findings.csv` indexes bounded TASK outputs contributed over time.
`Evidence_Register.csv` indexes all evidence citations used by the case.
`Candidate_Remedies.csv` records remedy candidates per issue or edge with owner workflow and evidence.
`Ruling_Register.csv` records human rulings and disposition state.
`Open_Questions.md` records active human-facing questions.
`Owner_Workflow_Handoff.md` records downstream handoffs by owning workflow.
`Case_QA.md` records validator status, case state, unresolved blockers, and closure boundary.
The method loads AGENT_TASK.md, the skill, and companion files.
The method resolves CASE_PATH and confirms it is under a PKG-00 control deliverable.
The method reads existing packet seeds and case files when present.
The method creates or updates the case receptacle files.
Prior packet artifacts must be preserved as seed evidence rather than active SCOPE_CHANGE intake.
Remedies must remain candidate-level unless human rulings and owner-workflow evidence support them.
The method writes a TASK run record with outputs and validation notes.
The worker must not claim dependency rows were changed.
The worker must not claim an SCC was closed unless a cited DepClosure snapshot proves it.
The worker must not claim SCOPE_CHANGE was initiated.
The worker must not claim project-wide blocker status.
Unknowns remain `TBD`.
Every candidate remedy must cite evidence or carry a `TBD` reason.
SCOPE_CHANGE is one possible owner workflow and not the default remedy.
SCC case organization is reasoning-first and requires no deterministic helper to author case files.
After case creation or update, preferred validation runs `python3 tools/validation/validate_scc_resolution_case.py <case-folder>`.
Validator PASS must not be claimed unless the validator actually ran and passed.
The tool policy disallows writes outside CASE_PATH and scoped `_run_records/`.
The tool policy disallows mutation of product deliverables.
The tool policy disallows mutation of `Dependencies.csv`.
The tool policy disallows mutation of `_ScopeChange/`, `_Reconciliation/`, or decomposition authority.
